approaches.idea: Single DFS returning the metric needed for "Longest Common Substring | (DP - 27)".
approaches.code:
def solve(root):
    ans = 0
    def dfs(n):
        nonlocal ans
        if not n: return 0
        L, R = dfs(n.left), dfs(n.right)
        # adapt combine for "Longest Common Substring | (DP - 27)"
        ans = max(ans, L + R)
        return 1 + max(L, R)
    dfs(root)
    return ans
